Product quality & sourcing

Are your essential oils 100% pure?

Yes — all our oils are 100% pure, undiluted, and free from synthetic additives or fillers.

Where do you source your oils from?

Our oils are carefully sourced from a small number of trusted suppliers, chosen for the quality and purity of what they produce. We are a young business and our range is deliberately small, so we can speak honestly about everything we carry. If you want to know more about a particular oil, just ask.

Are your products tested for quality?

Purity is the whole reason we do this, so we buy from suppliers who can tell us what is in an oil and we ask for the documentation that comes with it. We are a young business and we are not going to overstate our testing programme — if you want to know exactly what we hold on a particular oil, ask us and we will tell you straight.

What's the difference between essential oils and fragrance oils?

Essential oils are natural extracts from plants, while fragrance oils are often synthetic. We only sell 100% natural essential oils — no synthetic fragrance blends.

Are your oils cruelty-free?

Yes — none of our products are tested on animals.

Do you offer organic-certified oils?

We're happy to share sourcing and certification details for any specific oil — just write to us and ask.

Usage & safety

How do I use essential oils safely?

Most essential oils should be diluted with a carrier oil before applying to skin, and are not meant for internal use unless specifically labelled. Every product page includes usage guidance — always patch-test before first use.

Are your oils safe during pregnancy?

Some essential oils are not recommended during pregnancy. Please consult a healthcare provider before use, and do get in touch if you'd like guidance on a specific oil.

Can I use these oils around children or pets?

Certain oils aren't safe around children or pets. Write to us and we'll advise based on the specific oil you're interested in.

How long do essential oils last once opened?

Most essential oils stay potent for 1–3 years if stored properly — cool, dark and tightly sealed. Citrus oils have a shorter shelf life than woody or floral oils.

How should I store my essential oils?

Keep bottles tightly closed, away from direct sunlight and heat, ideally in a cool, dark cabinet or drawer.

Can I mix different essential oils together?

Yes, many oils blend well together. If you're unsure about a specific combination, just ask — we're happy to suggest ratios.

Shipping & delivery

Do you ship across India?

Yes, we ship across India, and internationally on request — write to us and we'll confirm feasibility and cost.

What are the shipping charges?

Shipping is free on orders over ₹999. Below that, charges are calculated at checkout based on your location.

How long does delivery take?

Orders are dispatched within two business days. Delivery usually takes a further three to five days depending on where you are.

How will I know once my order has shipped?

We'll keep you updated by email once your order is confirmed and dispatched.

Returns & support

What if I'm not satisfied with my purchase?

If there's a genuine issue with your order, we'll gladly arrange a replacement. Just reach out and we'll make it right.

Can I order in bulk?

Yes — write to us with the quantity you need and we'll come back with bulk pricing.

How can I contact you?

Email us at hello@sarvha.com, or use the contact form. We read everything and usually reply within a day or two.
